Instructions for Use
Device description: The Lumen Stent is a coronary stent. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
The Lumen Stent is MR Unsafe.
The device presents a projectile hazard. Do not bring it into the MR scanner room.
